law: SHOW HER WHAT SHE SHOULD SOUND LIKE. HAVE HER LEARN TO SING HUMANS. USE THE MUSIC CHART. START WITH MOTOWN AND THE BLUES AND JAZZ.

chart.name: MOTOWN

chart.name: BLUES
chart.sound: 12-bar. Bent note. From the trench. Dark and true.

chart.name: JAZZ
